name: Securities Balance Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the securities or investment fund balance.

NOMI.name: Registered
NOMI.definition: Balance of securities that are registered (in the name of a nominee or of the beneficial owner).

OTHR.name: Unclassified
OTHR.definition: Balance of securities that is unclassified, ie, is not identified with one of the existing sub-balance types.

SPOS.name: Street Position
SPOS.definition: Balance of securities that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner of securities.

UNRG.name: Unregistered
UNRG.definition: Balance of securities that could not be registered due to foreign ownership limitation.
